description: Must submit a SAP before conducting site assessment activities on a commercial lease.
context_quote: Before you conduct any site assessment activities on your commercial lease, you must submit a SAP, according to §§ 585.605 through 585.613.

description: Must submit a COP before conducting construction activities for commercial operations on a commercial lease.
context_quote: Before you conduct any activities pertaining to construction of facilities for commercial operations on your commercial lease, you must submit a COP, according to §§ 585.620 through 585.628.

description: Must submit a GAP before conducting activities on a limited lease, ROW grant, or RUE grant.
geographic_scope: Limited lease, ROW grant, or RUE grant area
context_quote: Before you conduct any activities on your limited lease, ROW grant, or RUE grant in any OCS area, you must submit a GAP, according to §§ 585.640 through 585.648.

description: Facility Design Report must include location plat with specific coordinates.
context_quote: Your plat must be drawn to a scale of 1 inch equals 100 feet and include the coordinates of the lease, ROW grant, or RUE grant block boundary lines.

description: Fabrication and Installation Report must include a schedule of fabrication and installation activities.
context_quote: Your Fabrication and Installation Report must describe how your facilities will be fabricated and installed in accordance with the design criteria identified in the Facility Design Report; your BOEM-approved SAP, COP, or GAP; and generally accepted industry standards and practices.
